test_cases.title: Suitability confirmation when all parameters match
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and Train Data is stored with Loading Gauge A, Axle Load Category 1, and Accepted Traction System X. Trackside sends route suitability data permitting Gauge A, Category 1, and Traction System X.
test_cases.test_inputs: Route suitability data: Permitted Gauges = [A], Permitted Axle Load Categories = [1], Traction System = X. Stored Train Data: Loading Gauge = A, Axle Load Category = 1, Accepted Traction Systems = [X].

steps.action: Send route suitability data from trackside to the OBU.
steps.expected: OBU receives the data and initiates comparison with stored Train Data.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's suitability status.
steps.expected: OBU reports no unsuitability (suitable).

test_cases.title: No traction unsuitability for engine without traction system
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and Train Data is stored for an engine that can run on a line without any traction system (e.g., diesel-only or self-propelled without external traction dependency). Trackside sends route suitability data with a specific traction system (e.g., Traction System Z).
test_cases.test_inputs: Route suitability data: Traction System = Z. Stored Train Data: Engine capability = 'Can run without traction system'.

steps.action: Send route suitability data from trackside to the OBU.
steps.expected: OBU receives the data and initiates comparison with stored Train Data.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's suitability status regarding traction system.
steps.expected: OBU does not report a traction system unsuitability.

test_cases.title: Operation without route suitability data
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in initial state. No route suitability data is transmitted by trackside.
test_cases.test_inputs: No route suitability data received.

steps.action: Allow the train to run without receiving any route suitability data from trackside.
steps.expected: OBU allows the train to run.

steps.action: Check if OBU uses or supervises any default route suitability values.
steps.expected: OBU does not use or supervise any default route suitability values.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal state regarding route suitability restrictions.
steps.expected: OBU state indicates that no route suitability restriction exists.

test_cases.title: Display appearance for auxiliary information without acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and connected to RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message with class 'auxiliary information' and 'acknowledgement not requested'.
test_cases.assumptions: The specific visual appearance (e.g., font, color, position) for auxiliary information is defined in the OBU HMI specification.

steps.action: Send a text message from trackside with class 'auxiliary information' and no driver acknowledgement request.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the message using the appearance defined for auxiliary information.

test_cases.title: Display appearance for important information with acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and connected to RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message with class 'important information' and 'acknowledgement requested'.
test_cases.assumptions: The specific visual appearance (e.g., font, color, position) for important information is defined in the OBU HMI specification.

steps.action: Send a text message from trackside with class 'important information' and driver acknowledgement requested.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the message using the appearance defined for important information.

test_cases.title: Start condition with multiple sub-conditions (OR logic)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message with start condition defined as 'Speed > 100 km/h OR Location = X'. Trackside defines logic as 'any'.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can simulate or be placed in a state where Speed is 50 km/h and Location is not X, then Speed becomes 120 km/h.

steps.action: Set OBU speed to 50 km/h and location away from X. Send the text message.
steps.expected: The message is not displayed.

steps.action: Increase OBU speed to 120 km/h while location remains away from X.
steps.expected: The start condition is fulfilled (one sub-condition met), and the message is displayed.

test_cases.title: Start condition with multiple sub-conditions (AND logic)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message with start condition defined as 'Speed > 100 km/h AND Location = X'. Trackside defines logic as 'all'.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can simulate or be placed in a state where Speed is 120 km/h and Location is not X.

steps.action: Set OBU speed to 120 km/h and location away from X. Send the text message.
steps.expected: The message is not displayed because not all sub-conditions are met.

steps.action: Move OBU to Location X while maintaining speed 120 km/h.
steps.expected: The start condition is fulfilled (all sub-conditions met), and the message is displayed.

test_cases.title: Start condition fulfilled immediately when no sub-conditions defined
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message with no start sub-conditions defined.

steps.action: Send a text message from trackside that defines none of the start sub-conditions.
steps.expected: The OBU treats the start condition as fulfilled immediately and displays the message (assuming end condition is not yet fulfilled).

test_cases.title: Driver acknowledgement ends display regardless of end condition
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message requesting driver confirmation, defined such that acknowledgement always ends display. End condition is 'Location = Y' (not yet reached).
test_cases.assumptions: The message is currently displayed.

steps.action: Display the text message.
steps.expected: The message is visible on the HMI.

steps.action: Driver acknowledges the message before reaching Location Y.
steps.expected: The text display ends immediately upon acknowledgement, even though the end condition (Location = Y) is not fulfilled.

test_cases.title: Driver acknowledgement is necessary condition in addition to end condition
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message requesting driver confirmation, defined such that acknowledgement is a necessary condition in addition to end condition 'Location = Y'.
test_cases.assumptions: The message is currently displayed.

steps.action: Display the text message.
steps.expected: The message is visible on the HMI.

steps.action: Driver acknowledges the message before reaching Location Y.
steps.expected: The text display continues because the end condition (Location = Y) is not yet fulfilled.

steps.action: Move OBU to Location Y.
steps.expected: The text display ends because both the end condition and driver acknowledgement are fulfilled.

test_cases.title: Message not displayed if end condition already fulfilled at start
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message with start condition 'Location = A' and end condition 'Location = B'. OBU is currently at Location B.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is physically located at the position corresponding to Location B.

steps.action: Send a text message where the start condition is fulfilled (OBU at A) but the end condition is already fulfilled (OBU at B).
steps.expected: The OBU does not display the message at all, even if driver confirmation is requested.

test_cases.title: Display length measured from start location sub-condition
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message with start condition 'Location = A OR Speed > 100' and end condition 'Location = B' (where B is 100m after A).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU starts at Location A with Speed 50 km/h.

steps.action: OBU is at Location A. Send the text message.
steps.expected: The message is displayed. The start condition is fulfilled by Location = A.

steps.action: OBU moves 50m from Location A (still before B).
steps.expected: The message is still displayed.

steps.action: OBU moves to Location B (100m from A).
steps.expected: The message display ends. The length was measured from Location A, not from any other potential start trigger.

test_cases.title: Driver acknowledgement report sent to RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and connected to RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message requesting a report of driver acknowledgement, with a specific text message identifier (e.g., 0x1234).
test_cases.assumptions: The RBC is monitoring for the acknowledgement report.

steps.action: Display the text message requesting driver acknowledgement report.
steps.expected: The message is visible on the HMI.

steps.action: Driver acknowledges the message.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a driver acknowledgement report to the RBC referenced in the request, including the text message identifier 0x1234.

test_cases.title: Reject duplicate text message identifier for unacknowledged message
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: First text message with identifier 0x5678 requesting acknowledgement report. Second text message with the same identifier 0x5678.

steps.action: Send the first text message with identifier 0x5678 requesting driver acknowledgement report.
steps.expected: The message is displayed and waiting for driver acknowledgement.

steps.action: Send a new text message with the same identifier 0x5678 before the driver acknowledges the first one.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the newly received text message.

test_cases.title: Infill MA ile OS/LS Mode Profile'ın referans noktası ötesinde silinmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, izlenen bir OS/LS Mode Profile'ı aktif olarak izlemektedir. Infill MA, referans konumu (infill reference location) bu Mode Profile'ın başlangıcının ötesinde (önünde) olacak şekilde gönderilir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA paketi, referans konumu OS/LS Mode Profile'ın başlangıcından önde olacak şekilde.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU'nun mevcut konumu ve izlenen Mode Profile'ın başlangıç konumu test ortamında bilinen ve ayarlanabilir değerlerdir.

steps.action: OBU'ya referans konumu OS/LS Mode Profile'ın başlangıcının ötesinde olan bir Infill MA gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, izlenen OS/LS Mode Profile'ı referans konumuna kadar korur ve referans konumunun ötesindeki kısmı siler.

steps.action: OBU'nun Mode Profile listesi ve aktif izleme durumu incelenir.
steps.expected: Mode Profile, referans konumundan itibaren silinmiş olarak görünür, referans konumundan önceki kısım aktif izleme altında kalır.

test_cases.title: Infill MA ile izlenen SH Mode Profile'ın referans konumu başlangıçta veya arkasında ise silinmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, izlenen bir SH (Supervised) Mode Profile'ı aktif olarak izlemektedir. Infill MA, referans konumu bu SH Mode Profile'ın başlangıç noktasında veya arkasında olacak şekilde gönderilir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA paketi, referans konumu SH Mode Profile'ın başlangıcında veya arkasında olacak şekilde.
test_cases.assumptions: SH Mode Profile'ın başlangıç konumu test ortamında sabitlenmiştir.

steps.action: OBU'ya referans konumu SH Mode Profile'ın başlangıç noktasında olan bir Infill MA gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, izlenen SH Mode Profile'ı tamamen siler.

steps.action: OBU'ya referans konumu SH Mode Profile'ın başlangıç noktasının arkasında olan bir Infill MA gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, izlenen SH Mode Profile'ı tamamen siler.

test_cases.title: Infill MA ile izlenen SH Mode Profile'ın referans konumu başlangıcın önünde ise korunması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, izlenen bir SH (Supervised) Mode Profile'ı aktif olarak izlemektedir. Infill MA, referans konumu bu SH Mode Profile'ın başlangıç noktasının önünde olacak şekilde gönderilir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA paketi, referans konumu SH Mode Profile'ın başlangıcının önünde olacak şekilde.
test_cases.assumptions: SH Mode Profile'ın başlangıç konumu test ortamında sabitlenmiştir.

steps.action: OBU'ya referans konumu SH Mode Profile'ın başlangıç noktasının önünde olan bir Infill MA gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, izlenen SH Mode Profile'ı silmez ve aktif izleme altında tutar.

steps.action: Infill MA içindeki Mode Profile ve SH balise group listesi verileri gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, Infill MA içindeki Mode Profile ve SH balise group listesi verilerini yok sayar (ignore).

test_cases.title: Mode Profile başlangıcında geçici EOA ve SvL (release speed olmadan) uygulanması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, bir Mode Profile'ı izlemektedir ancak henüz bu Mode Profile'ın moduna geçmemiştir. Mode Profile, başlangıç noktasında bir SvL (Supervised Limit) gerektirmektedir. MA'da LOA (Limit of Authority) verilmemiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Mode Profile başlangıç konumu, SvL gereksinimi olan bir profil.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU'nun mevcut hızı, geçici SvL hızından düşüktür.

steps.action: OBU, Mode Profile başlangıç noktasına yaklaşır.
steps.expected: OBU, Mode Profile başlangıcını geçici bir EOA (End of Authority) olarak ele alır.

steps.action: OBU'nun hız profili ve frenleme davranışı gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, Mode Profile başlangıcında release speed olmadan bir geçici SvL uygular ve bu noktada duracak şekilde frenler.

test_cases.title: Mode Profile başlangıcında SvL gerektirmeyen profil ve MA'da LOA varken geçici EOA/SvL davranışı (LOA profil başlangıcında veya ötesinde)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, bir Mode Profile'ı izlemektedir ancak henüz bu Mode Profile'ın moduna geçmemiştir. Mode Profile, başlangıç noktasında bir SvL gerektirmemektedir. MA'da bir LOA verilmektedir ve bu LOA, Mode Profile başlangıcında veya ötesindedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Mode Profile başlangıç konumu, SvL gerektirmeyen bir profil. MA'da LOA, profil başlangıcında veya ötesinde.
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.5 kuralları test ortamında geçerlidir.

steps.action: OBU, Mode Profile başlangıç noktasına yaklaşır.
steps.expected: OBU, Mode Profile başlangıcını geçici bir EOA olarak ele alır.

steps.action: OBU'nun hız profili gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, LOA verilmemiş gibi davranır (as if no LOA were given) ve Mode Profile başlangıcında release speed olmadan bir geçici SvL uygular.

test_cases.title: Mode Profile başlangıcında SvL gerektirmeyen profil ve MA'da LOA varken geçici EOA/SvL davranışı (LOA profil başlangıcının arkasında)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, bir Mode Profile'ı izlemektedir ancak henüz bu Mode Profile'ın moduna geçmemiştir. Mode Profile, başlangıç noktasında bir SvL gerektirmemektedir. MA'da bir LOA verilmektedir ve bu LOA, Mode Profile başlangıcının arkasındadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Mode Profile başlangıç konumu, SvL gerektirmeyen bir profil. MA'da LOA, profil başlangıcının arkasında.
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.5 kuralları test ortamında geçerlidir.

steps.action: OBU, Mode Profile başlangıç noktasına yaklaşır.
steps.expected: OBU, Mode Profile başlangıcını geçici bir EOA olarak ele alır.

steps.action: OBU'nun hız profili gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, Mode Profile başlangıcında release speed olmadan bir geçici SvL uygular.

test_cases.title: LX information replacement with same identity
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is powered on and in a state where it can receive LX information. An initial LX information packet with Identity ID 'ID-123' and Data 'Data-A' is already stored in the OBU.
test_cases.test_inputs: New LX information packet with Identity ID 'ID-123' and Data 'Data-B'.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a diagnostic interface or log to verify the stored LX information content.

steps.action: Verify the currently stored LX information for Identity ID 'ID-123'.
steps.expected: The stored data is 'Data-A'.

steps.action: Transmit the new LX information packet with Identity ID 'ID-123' and Data 'Data-B' to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new LX information.

steps.action: Read the stored LX information for Identity ID 'ID-123' from the OBU.
steps.expected: The stored data is 'Data-B', confirming the old information was replaced.

test_cases.title: LX information replacement with different identity
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is powered on. An initial LX information packet with Identity ID 'ID-123' and Data 'Data-A' is already stored in the OBU.
test_cases.test_inputs: New LX information packet with Identity ID 'ID-456' and Data 'Data-C'.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a diagnostic interface or log to verify the stored LX information content.

steps.action: Transmit the new LX information packet with Identity ID 'ID-456' and Data 'Data-C' to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new LX information.

steps.action: Read the stored LX information for Identity ID 'ID-123' from the OBU.
steps.expected: The stored data remains 'Data-A', as the new information had a different identity.

steps.action: Read the stored LX information for Identity ID 'ID-456' from the OBU.
steps.expected: The stored data is 'Data-C'.

test_cases.title: Phishing-resistant authentication option availability at AAL2
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account is registered and active in the VBP system.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid company representative credentials.
test_cases.assumptions: The system is configured to support AAL2 authentication levels as per NIST SP 800-63B-4.

steps.action: Log in to the VBP portal as a company representative.
steps.expected: The login page displays at least one authentication method that is classified as phishing-resistant (e.g., FIDO2/WebAuthn, Smart Card, or similar) for AAL2.

steps.action: Select the phishing-resistant authentication option and complete the authentication process.
steps.expected: The system successfully authenticates the user and grants access to the portal at AAL2.

test_cases.title: MFA ile başarılı kimlik doğrulama
test_cases.preconditions: Sistemde kayıtlı ve aktif bir şirket temsilcisi hesabı vardır. Hesap MFA yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli kullanıcı adı, geçerli parola, geçerli MFA kodu.
test_cases.assumptions: MFA cihazı veya uygulaması çalışır durumdadır.

steps.action: Kullanıcı adı ve parola girilerek giriş ekranına erişilir.
steps.expected: Sistem MFA doğrulama adımı için geçerli bir MFA kodu istemini gösterir.

steps.action: Geçerli MFA kodu girilir ve onaylanır.
steps.expected: Kimlik doğrulama başarılı olur ve kullanıcı AAL2 seviyesinde yetkilendirilmiş bir oturum açar.

test_cases.title: İki ayrı faktör kombinasyonu ile başarılı kimlik doğrulama
test_cases.preconditions: Sistemde kayıtlı ve aktif bir şirket temsilcisi hesabı vardır. Hesap iki ayrı faktör kombinasyonu (ör. Parola + SMS) yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli kullanıcı adı, geçerli parola, geçerli SMS kodu.
test_cases.assumptions: SMS altyapısı çalışır durumdadır ve test numarasına kod gönderilebilir.

steps.action: Kullanıcı adı ve parola girilerek giriş ekranına erişilir.
steps.expected: Sistem ikinci faktör olarak SMS kodu istemini gösterir.

steps.action: Telefona gelen geçerli SMS kodu girilir ve onaylanır.
steps.expected: Kimlik doğrulama başarılı olur ve kullanıcı AAL2 seviyesinde yetkilendirilmiş bir oturum açar.

test_cases.title: Geçersiz MFA kodu ile giriş denemesi
test_cases.preconditions: Sistemde kayıtlı ve aktif bir şirket temsilcisi hesabı vardır. Hesap MFA yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli kullanıcı adı, geçerli parola, geçersiz MFA kodu.

steps.action: Kullanıcı adı ve parola girilerek MFA adımına geçilir.
steps.expected: Sistem MFA kodu istemini gösterir.

steps.action: Geçersiz bir MFA kodu girilir ve onaylanır.
steps.expected: Kimlik doğrulama başarısız olur, hata mesajı gösterilir ve oturum açılmaz.

test_cases.title: Yalnızca parola ile giriş denemesi (İkinci faktör eksik)
test_cases.preconditions: Sistemde kayıtlı ve aktif bir şirket temsilcisi hesabı vardır. Hesap MFA veya çift faktör yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli kullanıcı adı, geçerli parola.

steps.action: Kullanıcı adı ve parola girilir.
steps.expected: Sistem ikinci faktör (MFA veya SMS) istemini gösterir ve doğrudan oturum açmaya izin vermez.

steps.action: İkinci faktör girilmeden işlemi tamamlamaya çalışılır (ör. iptal veya boş bırakma).
steps.expected: Giriş reddedilir, kullanıcı AAL2 seviyesinde yetkilendirilmez.

test_cases.title: AAL2 oturumunun inaktivite zaman aşımında yeniden kimlik doğrulama istenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı, AAL2 seviyesinde kimlik doğrulaması yapılmış bir oturumla VBP'ye giriş yapmıştır. VBP Yazılım Tasarım Belgesi §14'te tanımlanan inaktivite zaman aşımı süresi 15 dakika olarak kabul edilmiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli AAL2 oturum kimliği.
test_cases.assumptions: VBP Yazılım Tasarım Belgesi §14'te inaktivite zaman aşımı süresi 15 dakika olarak tanımlanmıştır.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, oturum açtıktan sonra 15 dakika boyunca hiçbir işlem yapmaz.
steps.expected: Sistem, inaktivite zaman aşımının dolmasıyla birlikte kullanıcıyı yeniden kimlik doğrulama ekranına yönlendirir.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, yeniden kimlik doğrulama ekranında AAL2 gereksinimlerini karşılayan kimlik bilgilerini girer.
steps.expected: Sistem, kimlik doğrulamayı başarıyla tamamlar ve kullanıcıyı önceki oturum durumuna geri döndürür.

test_cases.title: AAL2 oturumunun genel zaman aşımında yeniden kimlik doğrulama istenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı, AAL2 seviyesinde kimlik doğrulaması yapılmış bir oturumla VBP'ye giriş yapmıştır. VBP Yazılım Tasarım Belgesi §14'te tanımlanan genel zaman aşımı süresi 8 saat olarak kabul edilmiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli AAL2 oturum kimliği.
test_cases.assumptions: VBP Yazılım Tasarım Belgesi §14'te genel zaman aşımı süresi 8 saat olarak tanımlanmıştır.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, oturum açtıktan sonra 8 saat boyunca periyodik olarak (inaktivite zaman aşımını tetiklemeyecek şekilde) işlem yapar.
steps.expected: Sistem, genel zaman aşımının dolmasıyla birlikte kullanıcıyı yeniden kimlik doğrulama ekranına yönlendirir.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, yeniden kimlik doğrulama ekranında AAL2 gereksinimlerini karşılayan kimlik bilgilerini girer.
steps.expected: Sistem, kimlik doğrulamayı başarıyla tamamlar ve yeni bir oturum başlatır.

test_cases.title: Yeniden kimlik doğrulama sırasında AAL2 gereksinimlerini karşılamayan giriş denemesi
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı, AAL2 seviyesinde kimlik doğrulaması yapılmış bir oturumla VBP'ye giriş yapmıştır. Inaktivite zaman aşımı süresi dolmuştur ve sistem yeniden kimlik doğrulama istemektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: AAL2 gereksinimlerini karşılamayan (örneğin sadece AAL1 seviyesinde) kimlik bilgileri.
test_cases.assumptions: Sistem, NIST SP 800-63B-4 §5.2'ye uygun olarak AAL2 seviyesinde yeniden kimlik doğrulama gerektirmektedir.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, yeniden kimlik doğrulama ekranında AAL2 gereksinimlerini karşılamayan kimlik bilgilerini girer.
steps.expected: Sistem, kimlik doğrulamayı reddeder ve AAL2 seviyesinde kimlik doğrulama gerektirdiğine dair bir hata mesajı gösterir.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, oturuma devam etmeye çalışır.
steps.expected: Sistem, kullanıcıyı oturum dışına çıkarır veya erişimi engeller.

test_cases.title: Account recovery notification sent to representative
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists and is active. The representative's contact details (email/phone) are valid and configured in the system.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid credentials for the company representative account.
test_cases.assumptions: The notification channel (e.g., email) is monitored and accessible for verification.

steps.action: Initiate the account recovery process for the company representative account using valid credentials.
steps.expected: The system successfully processes the recovery request.

steps.action: Check the notification channel (e.g., email inbox) associated with the representative.
steps.expected: A notification message regarding the account recovery is received.

test_cases.title: Account recovery notification sent to designee
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists. A designee has been explicitly assigned to this account in the system configuration. The designee's contact details are valid.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid credentials for the company representative account.
test_cases.assumptions: The system logic prioritizes the designee for notifications when one is specified, or sends to both as per NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.2.3 interpretation. This test verifies the designee receives the notification.

steps.action: Initiate the account recovery process for the company representative account using valid credentials.
steps.expected: The system successfully processes the recovery request.

steps.action: Check the notification channel (e.g., email inbox) associated with the designated designee.
steps.expected: A notification message regarding the account recovery is received by the designee.

test_cases.title: Electronic notification addresses receive account notifications
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with at least one valid email address and one valid phone number registered as notification addresses.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger an account notification event (e.g., password change or new login).
test_cases.assumptions: The system is configured to send notifications via email and SMS as per NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.6.

test_cases.title: E-Devlet oturum süresi dolmadan VBP oturumunun devam etmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı e-Devlet üzerinden VBP'ye başarıyla giriş yapmıştır. E-Devlet assertion geçerlilik süresi (ör. 10 dakika) VBP oturum süresinden kısadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli e-Devlet oturumu bilgileri.

steps.action: E-Devlet oturumu sonlandırılır (ör. e-Devlet sitesinden çıkış yapılır).

steps.action: VBP'de bir form doldurulur ve gönderilir.

test_cases.title: Federation transaction initiation includes VBP identifier and nonce
test_cases.preconditions: VBP is configured with a valid identifier for e-Devlet federation. A test user is authenticated in VBP.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid user session, target service requiring e-Devlet federation.
test_cases.assumptions: Network traffic between VBP and e-Devlet can be intercepted or logged for inspection.

steps.action: Initiate a federation transaction from VBP to e-Devlet.
steps.expected: VBP sends an assertion request to e-Devlet.

steps.action: Inspect the assertion request payload sent by VBP.
steps.expected: The request contains a field identifying VBP.

steps.action: Inspect the assertion request payload sent by VBP.
steps.expected: The request contains a cryptographic nonce value.

test_cases.title: Assertion request nonce is unique per transaction
test_cases.preconditions: VBP is configured for e-Devlet federation. Network traffic can be inspected.
test_cases.test_inputs: Two consecutive federation transactions initiated by the same user.
test_cases.assumptions: The system generates a new nonce for each transaction as per cryptographic best practices implied by 'cryptographic nonce'.

steps.action: Initiate the first federation transaction and capture the nonce value (Nonce1).
steps.expected: The assertion request contains Nonce1.

steps.action: Initiate a second federation transaction and capture the nonce value (Nonce2).
steps.expected: The assertion request contains Nonce2.

steps.action: Compare Nonce1 and Nonce2.
steps.expected: Nonce1 is not equal to Nonce2.

test_cases.title: Setting a new phone number triggers authenticator binding process
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a pre-registered telephone number. The user is authenticated.
test_cases.test_inputs: New valid telephone number.
test_cases.assumptions: The system implements the NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.1.2 binding process, which typically involves sending a one-time code to the new number and verifying it.

steps.action: Navigate to the profile settings and select the option to change the pre-registered telephone number.
steps.expected: The system initiates the authenticator binding process (e.g., prompts for a new number and sends a verification code to the new number).

steps.action: Enter the new telephone number and submit the form.
steps.expected: A one-time verification code is sent to the new telephone number.

steps.action: Enter the received verification code into the system.
steps.expected: The system validates the code and successfully binds the new telephone number as the authenticator.

steps.action: Check the account profile details.
steps.expected: The pre-registered telephone number is updated to the new number.

test_cases.title: Changing phone number without verification code fails
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a pre-registered telephone number. The user is authenticated.
test_cases.test_inputs: New valid telephone number, incorrect verification code.
test_cases.assumptions: The binding process requires a valid one-time code sent to the new number.

steps.action: Initiate the change of the pre-registered telephone number and enter a new number.
steps.expected: The system sends a verification code to the new number.

steps.action: Enter an incorrect verification code.
steps.expected: The system rejects the code and displays an error message. The telephone number is not changed.

steps.action: Check the account profile details.
steps.expected: The pre-registered telephone number remains the original number.

test_cases.title: Attempting to bypass binding process by direct API call or UI manipulation
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists. The user is authenticated.
test_cases.test_inputs: Direct API request to update phone number without OTP verification.
test_cases.assumptions: The system enforces the binding process server-side, not just in the UI.

steps.action: Send a direct API request to update the telephone number field without providing a verification code or completing the binding flow.
steps.expected: The system rejects the request with an error indicating that the authenticator binding process is required.

steps.action: Check the account profile details via a valid authenticated request.
steps.expected: The telephone number has not been changed.

test_cases.title: Binding a second authenticator to an account with one existing authenticator
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with one active authenticator bound.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid credentials for the account, details for a new authenticator (e.g., new phone number or security key).
test_cases.assumptions: The system supports at least two authenticators per account as per NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.1.2.1.

steps.action: Log in to the company representative account using the existing authenticator.
steps.expected: The user is successfully authenticated and redirected to the account settings or security page.

steps.action: Navigate to the authenticator management section and select the option to add a new authenticator.
steps.expected: The system displays a form or prompt to register a new authenticator.

steps.action: Enter the details for the new authenticator and complete the verification process.
steps.expected: The system confirms the successful binding of the new authenticator.

steps.action: View the list of bound authenticators for the account.
steps.expected: Both the original and the newly added authenticator are listed as active.

test_cases.title: Binding a third authenticator to an account with two existing authenticators
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with two active authenticators bound.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid credentials for the account, details for a third new authenticator.
test_cases.assumptions: The system allows more than two authenticators per account.

steps.action: Log in to the company representative account using one of the existing authenticators.
steps.expected: The user is successfully authenticated.

steps.action: Navigate to the authenticator management section and select the option to add a new authenticator.
steps.expected: The system displays a form or prompt to register a new authenticator.

steps.action: Enter the details for the third authenticator and complete the verification process.
steps.expected: The system confirms the successful binding of the third authenticator.

steps.action: View the list of bound authenticators for the account.
steps.expected: All three authenticators are listed as active.

test_cases.title: Attempting to bind an authenticator that is already bound to the account
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with one active authenticator bound.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid credentials for the account, details for the same authenticator already bound.
test_cases.assumptions: The system prevents duplicate binding of the same authenticator to the same account.

steps.action: Log in to the company representative account.
steps.expected: The user is successfully authenticated.

steps.action: Navigate to the authenticator management section and select the option to add a new authenticator.
steps.expected: The system displays a form or prompt to register a new authenticator.

steps.action: Enter the details for the authenticator that is already bound to the account and attempt to verify.
steps.expected: The system rejects the request and displays an error message indicating that the authenticator is already bound.

steps.action: View the list of bound authenticators for the account.
steps.expected: Only the original authenticator is listed; no duplicate entry is created.

test_cases.title: Authentication required at lower AAL when account max is lower than authenticator max
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a maximum available AAL of 2. A new authenticator capable of AAL 3 is ready to be bound.
test_cases.test_inputs: Account with max AAL 2, New authenticator with max AAL 3
test_cases.assumptions: The system supports AAL levels 1, 2, and 3 as per NIST SP 800-63B-4.

steps.action: Initiate the process to bind the new authenticator to the account.
steps.expected: The system prompts for authentication.

steps.action: Provide authentication credentials corresponding to AAL 2.
steps.expected: The authentication is accepted, and the new authenticator is successfully bound to the account.

test_cases.title: Authentication required at lower AAL when authenticator max is lower than account max
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a maximum available AAL of 3. A new authenticator capable of AAL 2 is ready to be bound.

test_cases.assumptions: The system supports AAL levels 1, 2, and 3 as per NIST SP 800-63B-4.

steps.action: Initiate the process to bind the new authenticator to the account.
steps.expected: The system prompts for authentication.

steps.action: Provide authentication credentials corresponding to AAL 2.
steps.expected: The authentication is accepted, and the new authenticator is successfully bound to the account.

test_cases.title: Authentication required at AAL 1 when both account and authenticator max are AAL 1
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a maximum available AAL of 1. A new authenticator capable of AAL 1 is ready to be bound.
test_cases.test_inputs: Account with max AAL 1, New authenticator with max AAL 1
test_cases.assumptions: AAL 1 is the minimum supported level.

steps.action: Initiate the process to bind the new authenticator to the account.
steps.expected: The system prompts for authentication.

steps.action: Provide authentication credentials corresponding to AAL 1.
steps.expected: The authentication is accepted, and the new authenticator is successfully bound to the account.

test_cases.title: Authentication failure when providing lower AAL than required
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a maximum available AAL of 2. A new authenticator capable of AAL 3 is ready to be bound. The required AAL is 2.
test_cases.test_inputs: Account with max AAL 2, New authenticator with max AAL 3, Authentication attempt at AAL 1
test_cases.assumptions: The system enforces the minimum required AAL for binding.

steps.action: Initiate the process to bind the new authenticator to the account.
steps.expected: The system prompts for authentication.

steps.action: Provide authentication credentials corresponding to AAL 1.
steps.expected: The authentication is rejected, and an error message indicating insufficient authentication level is displayed.

test_cases.title: Government identifier and core attributes validation against authoritative source
test_cases.preconditions: A test user profile is created with IAL2 assurance level. The authoritative source (e.g., government database) contains matching records for the test user's government identifier and core attributes.
test_cases.test_inputs: Government identifier: TR12345678901, Name: John Doe, Date of Birth: 1990-01-01, Address: 123 Main St, City: Ankara
test_cases.assumptions: The authoritative source is accessible and returns a match for the provided attributes.

steps.action: Submit a company representative proofing request with IAL2 level using the provided government identifier and core attributes.
steps.expected: The system initiates validation against the authoritative source.

steps.action: Wait for the validation process to complete.
steps.expected: The system returns a success status indicating that all core attributes have been validated.

test_cases.title: Validation of digitally signed attributes on SUPERIOR evidence
test_cases.preconditions: A test user profile is created with IAL2 assurance level. A digitally signed evidence document (SUPERIOR) is generated with a valid signature from a trusted issuer.
test_cases.test_inputs: Digitally signed evidence document containing: Name: Jane Smith, Government Identifier: TR98765432109, Issuer Public Key: [Valid Key]
test_cases.assumptions: The issuer's public key is registered in the system's trust store and the signature is cryptographically valid.

steps.action: Submit a company representative proofing request with IAL2 level using the digitally signed evidence document.
steps.expected: The system verifies the digital signature using the issuer's public key.

steps.action: Wait for the validation process to complete.
steps.expected: The system returns a success status indicating that the digitally signed attributes have been validated.

test_cases.title: Validation failure due to mismatched government identifier
test_cases.preconditions: A test user profile is created with IAL2 assurance level. The authoritative source does not contain a record matching the provided government identifier.
test_cases.test_inputs: Government identifier: TR00000000000, Name: Invalid User, Date of Birth: 1985-05-05
test_cases.assumptions: The authoritative source is accessible and returns no match for the provided government identifier.

steps.action: Submit a company representative proofing request with IAL2 level using the non-matching government identifier.
steps.expected: The system initiates validation against the authoritative source.

steps.action: Wait for the validation process to complete.
steps.expected: The system returns a failure status indicating that the government identifier could not be validated.

test_cases.title: Validation failure due to invalid digital signature
test_cases.preconditions: A test user profile is created with IAL2 assurance level. A digitally signed evidence document is provided with an invalid or tampered signature.
test_cases.test_inputs: Digitally signed evidence document containing: Name: Tampered User, Government Identifier: TR11111111111, Issuer Public Key: [Valid Key], Signature: [Invalid/Tampered]
test_cases.assumptions: The issuer's public key is registered in the system's trust store, but the signature does not match the document content.

steps.action: Submit a company representative proofing request with IAL2 level using the evidence document with an invalid signature.
steps.expected: The system attempts to verify the digital signature using the issuer's public key.

steps.action: Wait for the validation process to complete.
steps.expected: The system returns a failure status indicating that the digital signature validation failed.

test_cases.title: Company representative identity verification does not use knowledge-based methods
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account is registered in the system. The identity verification flow for company representatives is accessible.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid company representative credentials.
test_cases.assumptions: The system allows initiating the identity verification process for a company representative without completing it fully, or provides a UI that lists available verification methods.

steps.action: Initiate the identity verification process for a company representative account.
steps.expected: The system presents verification options that do not include knowledge-based verification (e.g., no questions about previous addresses, mother's maiden name, or other personal history).

steps.action: Review the available verification methods in the user interface or API response.
steps.expected: Only non-knowledge-based methods (such as document upload, biometric, or out-of-band codes) are offered, in compliance with NIST SP 800-63A-4 §2.5.1.

test_cases.title: Email-based out-of-band authentication is not available

steps.action: Navigate to the login page and initiate the authentication process for a registered user.
steps.expected: The authentication options presented do not include any method that sends a code or link via email for out-of-band verification.

steps.action: Attempt to trigger an email-based authentication flow if such an option is hidden or accessible via API/URL manipulation.
steps.expected: The system does not send any email for authentication purposes and rejects or ignores the request for out-of-band email authentication.

test_cases.title: SMS code generation does not reset failed authentication count
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a non-zero failed authentication count (e.g., 2 failed attempts).
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid company representative credentials, valid phone number associated with the account.
test_cases.assumptions: The system allows generating a new SMS code after failed attempts without requiring a full reset.

steps.action: Log in with incorrect credentials twice to establish a failed authentication count of 2.
steps.expected: The system records 2 failed authentication attempts for the account.

steps.action: Initiate the process to generate a new SMS one-time code for the company representative.
steps.expected: A new SMS one-time code is generated and sent to the registered phone number.

steps.action: Check the account's failed authentication count in the system logs or database.
steps.expected: The failed authentication count remains 2 and has not been reset to 0.

test_cases.title: SMS code generation preserves failed count at lockout threshold boundary
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a failed authentication count equal to the maximum allowed before lockout (e.g., 4 out of 5).
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid company representative credentials, valid phone number associated with the account.
test_cases.assumptions: The lockout threshold is 5 failed attempts. The system allows SMS code generation at this boundary.

steps.action: Log in with incorrect credentials 4 times to reach the boundary of the failed authentication count.
steps.expected: The system records 4 failed authentication attempts for the account.

steps.action: Initiate the process to generate a new SMS one-time code for the company representative.
steps.expected: A new SMS one-time code is generated and sent to the registered phone number.

steps.action: Check the account's failed authentication count in the system logs or database.
steps.expected: The failed authentication count remains 4 and has not been reset to 0.

steps.action: Attempt to log in with incorrect credentials one more time.
steps.expected: The system records the 5th failed attempt and locks the account according to policy.

test_cases.title: SMS code generation with invalid phone number does not reset failed count
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a non-zero failed authentication count (e.g., 1 failed attempt).
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid company representative credentials, invalid or unregistered phone number.
test_cases.assumptions: The system validates the phone number before sending the SMS code.

steps.action: Log in with incorrect credentials once to establish a failed authentication count of 1.
steps.expected: The system records 1 failed authentication attempt for the account.

steps.action: Initiate the process to generate a new SMS one-time code using an invalid phone number.
steps.expected: The system displays an error message indicating the phone number is invalid or not registered.

steps.action: Check the account's failed authentication count in the system logs or database.
steps.expected: The failed authentication count remains 1 and has not been reset to 0.

test_cases.title: Multiple authenticator failure threshold triggers full disablement
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with password and second-factor (e.g., TOTP) enabled. The account is not currently locked or disabled. The failure threshold defined in VBP SDD §14 is known (assumed to be 5 for this test).
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid username, invalid password, invalid second-factor code.
test_cases.assumptions: The failure threshold in VBP SDD §14 is 5 consecutive failed attempts. The system tracks failures per authenticator type and per account.

steps.action: Attempt login with valid username, invalid password, and valid second-factor code.
steps.expected: Authentication fails. Password failure count increments to 1.

steps.action: Attempt login with valid username, valid password, and invalid second-factor code.
steps.expected: Authentication fails. Second-factor failure count increments to 1.

steps.action: Repeat the sequence of invalid password and invalid second-factor attempts until the total consecutive failed authentication attempts on the account reach the threshold (5 attempts total, involving both authenticators).
steps.expected: The 5th failed attempt triggers the threshold condition.

steps.action: Check the status of the password authenticator for the account.
steps.expected: The password authenticator is disabled.

steps.action: Check the status of the second-factor authenticator for the account.
steps.expected: The second-factor authenticator is disabled.

steps.action: Attempt login with valid username, valid password, and valid second-factor code.
steps.expected: Authentication is rejected because the authenticators are disabled.

test_cases.title: Single authenticator failure does not disable other authenticators
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with password and second-factor enabled. The account is not currently locked or disabled. The failure threshold is 5.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid username, invalid password, valid second-factor code.
test_cases.assumptions: The requirement specifies disabling 'all of the authenticators involved' in consecutive failed attempts that reach the threshold. If only one authenticator is involved in the failures, only that one should be affected, or the condition 'more than one authenticator is involved' is not met, so no disabling occurs per the specific clause. However, standard lockout might apply. This test verifies that if the condition 'more than one authenticator involved' is NOT met, the specific multi-authenticator disablement logic is not triggered.

steps.action: Attempt login 5 times with valid username, invalid password, and valid second-factor code.
steps.expected: Authentication fails 5 times. Only the password authenticator is involved in the failures.

steps.action: Check the status of the second-factor authenticator for the account.
steps.expected: The second-factor authenticator remains enabled (not disabled by the multi-authenticator rule).

test_cases.title: Failure threshold not reached with multiple authenticators
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with password and second-factor enabled. The failure threshold is 5.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid username, invalid password, invalid second-factor code.
test_cases.assumptions: The failure threshold in VBP SDD §14 is 5 consecutive failed attempts.

steps.action: Attempt login 4 times with valid username, invalid password, and invalid second-factor code.
steps.expected: Authentication fails 4 times. The threshold (5) is not reached.

steps.action: Check the status of the password authenticator.
steps.expected: The password authenticator remains enabled.

steps.action: Check the status of the second-factor authenticator.
steps.expected: The second-factor authenticator remains enabled.

test_cases.title: Disabled authenticator re-binding requirement
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists. An authenticator is bound to this account. The failed-attempt threshold defined in VBP SDD §14 is 3.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid company representative credentials, valid authenticator secret.
test_cases.assumptions: The failed-attempt threshold is 3. The re-binding process requires entering the authenticator code and confirming the binding.

steps.action: Enter incorrect authenticator codes 3 times during login.

steps.expected: The system rejects the authenticator and prompts for re-binding.

steps.action: Initiate the re-binding process for the disabled authenticator.
steps.expected: The system displays the re-binding interface as described in NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.1.

steps.action: Complete the re-binding process by providing the correct authenticator code.
steps.expected: The authenticator is successfully bound to the company representative account again.

steps.action: Attempt to log in using the re-bound authenticator.
steps.expected: The login is successful.

test_cases.title: Re-binding failure with incorrect code

test_cases.test_inputs: Valid company representative credentials, incorrect authenticator code.

steps.action: Attempt to log in using the authenticator.
steps.expected: The system rejects the authenticator as it is still disabled.

test_cases.title: Session AAL must not exceed authentication event AAL
test_cases.preconditions: A user account exists with authentication capabilities for AAL1 and AAL2. The system allows session creation via authentication events.
test_cases.test_inputs: User credentials for AAL1 authentication. A request to establish a session with AAL2 context.
test_cases.assumptions: The system exposes a mechanism or API parameter to request a specific AAL level for the session, or the session context is derived from the authentication method used. For this test, we assume an attempt to force or simulate a higher AAL session context after a lower AAL authentication.

steps.action: Authenticate the user using a method that establishes an AAL1 authentication event.
steps.expected: The authentication event is recorded as AAL1. A session is created.

steps.action: Attempt to access a resource or perform an action that requires or implies an AAL2 session context, or explicitly request the session to be treated as AAL2.
steps.expected: The system rejects the request or denies access. The session is not treated as AAL2. The system may prompt for re-authentication at AAL2 or return an error indicating insufficient AAL.

test_cases.title: Session AAL can be lower than authentication event AAL
test_cases.preconditions: A user account exists with authentication capabilities for AAL2. The system allows session creation via authentication events.
test_cases.test_inputs: User credentials for AAL2 authentication. A request to establish a session with AAL1 context.
test_cases.assumptions: The system allows the session to be downgraded to a lower AAL than the authentication event, as permitted by NIST SP 800-63B-4 §5.1.

steps.action: Authenticate the user using a method that establishes an AAL2 authentication event.
steps.expected: The authentication event is recorded as AAL2. A session is created.

steps.action: Access a resource or perform an action that requires only AAL1, or explicitly request the session to be treated as AAL1.
steps.expected: The system accepts the request. The session is treated as AAL1 (or lower) for this context. Access is granted.

test_cases.title: Authenticated session remains on HTTPS after navigation
test_cases.preconditions: A valid user account exists. The user is authenticated via HTTPS.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid credentials, internal link to a protected resource.

steps.action: Log in to the VBP portal using HTTPS with valid credentials.
steps.expected: The user is successfully authenticated and the session is established over HTTPS.

steps.action: Navigate to a protected internal page within the portal.
steps.expected: The browser address bar displays 'https://' and the connection remains secure.

steps.action: Check the HTTP response headers of the current session.
steps.expected: The response does not contain a 'Location' header redirecting to 'http://' and the 'Strict-Transport-Security' header is present if applicable.

test_cases.title: Prevention of downgrade from HTTPS to HTTP
test_cases.preconditions: The user is authenticated via HTTPS.
test_cases.test_inputs: Manual URL modification to HTTP.
test_cases.assumptions: The test environment allows manual URL manipulation in the browser address bar.

steps.action: Log in to the VBP portal using HTTPS with valid credentials.
steps.expected: The user is successfully authenticated and the session is established over HTTPS.

steps.action: Manually change the URL scheme from 'https' to 'http' in the browser address bar and press Enter.
steps.expected: The system redirects the request back to the HTTPS version of the URL or rejects the insecure connection, maintaining the secure session context.

steps.action: Verify the final URL and connection status.
steps.expected: The browser displays 'https://' and the session remains active without falling back to an insecure transport.

test_cases.title: Bot trafiğinin WAF tarafından engellenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Web Application Firewall (WAF) kuralları aktif ve NIST SP 800-63A-4 §3.5 uyumlu yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Otomatize edilmiş (bot) istekler içeren HTTP trafiği.
test_cases.assumptions: WAF loglarına erişim yetkisi vardır.

steps.action: Tanımlı bot imzalarına sahip otomatize bir istek, şirket temsilcisi kimlik doğrulama (identity proofing) endpoint'ine gönderilir.
steps.expected: İstek WAF tarafından reddedilir (403 veya 429 yanıtı) ve kimlik doğrulama işlemi başlatılmaz.

steps.action: WAF olay günlüğü (log) kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: İlgili istek için 'bot detection' veya 'attack mitigation' olay kaydı oluşturulmuştur.

test_cases.title: Anormal davranış analitiği ile oturumun askıya alınması
test_cases.preconditions: Davranış analitiği (behavioural analytics) modülü aktif ve eşik değerleri tanımlıdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Kısa sürede çok sayıda başarısız kimlik doğrulama denemesi veya anormal veri girişi hızı.
test_cases.assumptions: Davranış analitiği eşik değerleri test ortamında düşük tutulmuştur.

steps.action: Şirket temsilcisi kimlik doğrulama sürecinde, tanımlı eşik değerini aşan anormal bir davranış deseni (örneğin, saniyede 10'dan fazla hata) oluşturulur.
steps.expected: Sistem, davranış analitiği motoru tarafından tespit edilen anomali nedeniyle oturumu askıya alır veya ek doğrulama (step-up) ister.

steps.action: Kullanıcı arayüzü gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: Kullanıcıya güvenlik ihlali veya ek doğrulama gerektiğine dair bilgilendirme mesajı gösterilir.

test_cases.title: Ağ trafiği analizi ile enjeksiyon saldırısının engellenmesi

test_cases.test_inputs: SQL enjeksiyonu veya XSS içeren zararlı ağ paketleri.
test_cases.assumptions: Ağ trafiği analizi araçlarının alarm eşikleri test için ayarlanmıştır.

steps.action: Şirket temsilcisi kimlik doğrulama API'sine, SQL enjeksiyonu içeren zararlı bir ağ paketi gönderilir.
steps.expected: Ağ trafiği analizi aracı saldırıyı tespit eder ve trafiği engeller veya uyarı üretir.

steps.action: Kimlik doğrulama sunucusunun yanıtı kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Sunucu, zararlı girdiyi işlemez ve standart hata veya engelleme yanıtı döndürür.

test_cases.title: NIST SP 800-63A-4 §3.5 uyumlu koruma mekanizmalarının etkinliği

test_cases.title: Failed sign-in response consistency for existing and non-existing users
test_cases.preconditions: A valid user account exists in the system. A non-existing user identifier is known.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid user ID, invalid password; Non-existing user ID, invalid password.
test_cases.assumptions: The system is accessible and network latency is stable.

steps.action: Attempt sign-in with a valid user ID and an incorrect password.
steps.expected: The system returns a generic error message (e.g., 'Invalid credentials') and a specific HTTP status code (e.g., 401). Record the response time.

steps.action: Attempt sign-in with a non-existing user ID and an incorrect password.
steps.expected: The system returns the exact same generic error message and HTTP status code as in step 1. The response time should be statistically similar to step 1 (no significant delay indicating user existence check).

test_cases.title: Failed registration response consistency for existing and non-existing users
test_cases.preconditions: A valid user email/ID already exists in the system. A new, non-existing email/ID is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: Existing user email, valid registration data; Non-existing user email, valid registration data.
test_cases.assumptions: Registration endpoint is accessible.

steps.action: Submit a registration request with an email address that already exists in the system.
steps.expected: The system returns a generic error message (e.g., 'Registration failed' or 'Invalid input') and a specific HTTP status code. Record the response time.

steps.action: Submit a registration request with a new, non-existing email address.
steps.expected: The system returns the exact same generic error message and HTTP status code as in step 1 (if the registration fails for other reasons) or a generic success message that does not reveal the previous state. If the requirement implies failure for duplicates, the error message must not explicitly state 'User already exists' in a way that differs from other validation errors, or it must be indistinguishable from other failures. *Assumption: If the system allows duplicate emails, this test is invalid. Assuming unique email constraint.* The response time should be similar.

test_cases.title: Forgotten password response consistency for existing and non-existing users
test_cases.preconditions: A valid user email exists in the system. A non-existing email is known.
test_cases.test_inputs: Existing user email; Non-existing user email.
test_cases.assumptions: Email sending mechanism is mocked or monitored to verify no email is sent for non-existing users, but the UI response is the focus.

steps.action: Submit a forgotten password request with an email address that exists in the system.
steps.expected: The system displays a generic success message (e.g., 'If the email exists, a reset link has been sent') and returns a specific HTTP status code (e.g., 200). Record the response time.

steps.action: Submit a forgotten password request with an email address that does not exist in the system.
steps.expected: The system displays the exact same generic success message and returns the same HTTP status code as in step 1. The response time should be statistically similar to step 1.

test_cases.title: Help Desk initiates password reset without setting password

steps.action: Click 'Initiate Password Reset'.
steps.expected: The system triggers the password reset process (e.g., sends a reset link to the user's email). The interface does not provide a field to enter or select a new password.

steps.action: Verify the UI elements available after initiating the reset.
steps.expected: No input fields for 'New Password' or 'Confirm Password' are present in the Help Desk view for this action.

test_cases.title: Help Desk cannot directly change representative's password
test_cases.preconditions: A Help Desk staff account is logged in. A company representative account exists.

steps.action: Inspect the Help Desk interface for any 'Change Password' or 'Set Password' button/field for the company representative.

test_cases.title: New session token generation and old token invalidation upon re-authentication
test_cases.preconditions: User is authenticated with a valid session token (Token A).
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid credentials for re-authentication.

steps.action: Initiate re-authentication process with valid credentials.
steps.expected: System accepts the credentials and generates a new session token (Token B).

steps.action: Attempt to access a protected resource using the previous session token (Token A).
steps.expected: Access is denied, and the system indicates that the session is invalid or terminated.

steps.action: Attempt to access a protected resource using the new session token (Token B).
steps.expected: Access is granted successfully.

test_cases.title: Session data invalidation upon logout
test_cases.preconditions: User is authenticated with a valid session token.

steps.action: Execute the logout action.
steps.expected: System confirms logout and terminates the session.

steps.action: Attempt to access a protected resource using the session token obtained before logout.
steps.expected: Access is denied, and the system indicates that the session is invalid.

test_cases.title: Session data invalidation upon expiration
test_cases.preconditions: User is authenticated with a valid session token. The session timeout duration is known and can be waited out or simulated.
test_cases.assumptions: Session timeout duration is short enough for testing or can be manipulated in the test environment.

steps.action: Wait for the session to expire (or simulate expiration).
steps.expected: Session state is marked as expired in the backend.

steps.action: Attempt to access a protected resource using the expired session token.
steps.expected: Access is denied, and the system indicates that the session has expired or is invalid.
